opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 individuals with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions, and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Funds the formation of new two-year synthesis groups to fast-track innovative and impactful research by bringing together diverse interdisciplinary groups to analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-Term Research Grants

amount.raw: Up to £500 per year for a decade of data collection; first five years' worth claimed in year 1 (£3,500), with an additional £3,500 claimable in year 6.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners and university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world, funding the annual cost of a few days of data gathering over a long period.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Funds research informing teaching and learning practices in ecology to improve learners' experience and promote excellence in teaching, providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning.

opportunities.title: Connecting Ecologists with Other Disciplines Grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Promotes interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world where ecology can make a difference.

opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; no restrictions on where applicants come from or carry out work.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for in-person events.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member and a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (postdoc researchers, undergraduates and masters students not eligible); must work or study at a university or research institution.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member, a citizen of and based in a Global South country, travelling from and returning to that country, and must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering costs directly related to attending the meeting.
